def: probably akin to G1507 (εἱλίσσω)); to entwine, i.e. wind up in

occurrences.text: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
